statement: In the pinned xpadneo kernel code, BTN_SHARE is an internal alias for KEY_F12. Its input mapping assigns the Share usage to that alias, removes the Share/F12 capability from the gamepad node, and forwards actual Share key events to a separate keyboard node. Therefore a Series controller under xpadneo need not expose the stock xpad gamepad Share event KEY_RECORD; the pinned code and its README agree on keyboard F12.
